newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * The government is expected to meet trade union leaders on Monday to agree on a social pact vital for the centrist cabinet's planned tough reforms.
* Future steps to bring prices in line with the new leu-dollar exchange rate should be parallelled by social protection measures, ruling National Peasant Party (PNT-CD) leaders said.
* The government will negotiate with the World Bank the terms of a social protection loan to cushion the effects of recent and future price hikes, PNT-CD secretary general Radu Vasile said.
* The National Bank (BNR) should intensify control over loans given by state-run commercial banks, Vasile said. He said such loans had slipped BNR control so far.
* Romania has set an example of good inter-ethnic relations since the Hungarian Democratic Union has joined the country's centrist ruling coalition, said the Project on Ethnic Relations chairman.

The official said a regional conference -- with Romania, Slovakia, Ukraine, Hungary, Serbia and the United States and the European Union attending -- would be held in February in Austria to analyse latest ethnic tensions in the region.
* French European Affairs Minister Michel Barnier will arrive in Bucharest on Tuesday to prepare an official visit to Romania by French President Jacques Chirac, scheduled for next month.
Chirac's visit is vital for Romania's efforts to get quick admission to both the NATO and the EU, Romanian Foreign Ministry officials said. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264 REUTER
